Kamianyi Brid Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zhytomyr Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This cemetery was established in 1919 specifically to bury the victims of that year's pogrom, in which about 250 of Kamianyi Brid's Jews were murdered; it was also used by Jews from the nearby community of Dovbysh. The town's main employer was a faience (pottery) factory owned by the Austrian Jew A. F. Sussmann, where the Bund was active among the workforce. Yuri Kanner, head of the Russian Jewish Congress, was born in Kamianyi Brid in 1955. A monument to Holocaust victims was opened here in 2013.
